rationale: Builds on the current reverse recurrent-tail baseline but reallocates recurrence strength toward later sequence positions, which are overrepresented by the exact sliding-window validation. This is a compile-stable structural edit, not another scalar sweep, and it preserves the proven quant-aware endgame and export path while biasing tail carry/reuse where the final metric is most sensitive.
title: Late-Position Tail Recurrence Focus
